extracts.scope: Complete chapters28–29 and chapter30 through the opening of30.5; not complete chapter30.

findings.assessment: Projection versus population effect, 11 unavailable sparse-cell replications, conditional/unconditional coverage and heteroskedastic adverse comparisons remain distinct. Three observationally equivalent causal systems retain opposite net-value signs. Panel weights target different questions. UCI duration is unavailable before calling and prediction among contacted records does not identify targeting benefit.

445 retained participants, assignment versus receipt, selection premise, historical earnings units and approximate finite-population uncertainty are explicit. HC2/HC3 and adjustment comparisons do not imply finite-sample superiority. The cost hurdle changes the recommendation. Interface agreement preserves supplied summaries and does not qualify raw-data endpoints.

Model/observation/target/sampling definitions precede computational types. Fixed per-unit transformations and iid sampling are prerequisites for the gradient argument. Learned encoders and panel transformations are excluded from that simple argument. The bounded implementation regimes and uncertainty representations preserve refusal, unbounded sets, numerical unknowns and declared limitations.

The generated example, public experiment, search oracle, source observations and proposed investment remain differentiated. The software-benefit account does not count deposit contribution as incremental software value. Actual costs, matched-study savings and bank adoption are unestablished.
This bounded rereading cannot settle proportionality, repeated qualifications or typography across1941 pages. Existing full-context author records do not become independent acceptance.

disposition: Additional author reading supports current limited claims; neither independent nor fresh visual acceptance is established.
